existing_rows_audit.detail: Amsterdam office is real (Locatellikade 1, per https://www.drw.com/contact-us) and a C++ seat is live, but the posted title is "Senior Software Engineer, Trading Platform, C++" at https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/drweng/jobs/7975947. The row's eligibility claim ("New-grad OR entry-level req — recent grads accepted") is WRONG: the posting demands a minimum of 5 years of C++ experience.

London office confirmed (The Leadenhall Building) and 41 reqs are live. The C++ core-infrastructure seat is titled "Senior Software Engineer, Trading Platform, C++" at https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/drweng/jobs/7976003, again with a 5-year minimum — the row's "new-grad accepted" verdict is wrong.

Singapore office confirmed (Asia Square Tower 1) with 16 live reqs. The equivalent seat is posted as "Senior Software Engineer" (Core Infrastructure C++ body text) at https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/drweng/jobs/7725410, 5-year minimum. The nearer-fit Singapore C++ req is "Quantitative Developer – Equity Options" (3+ years) at https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/drweng/jobs/5100405.

The Montreal office genuinely exists (listed on https://www.drw.com/contact-us) and carries 14-15 live reqs on the board, so the office claim is sound — but Canada is explicitly out of scope for this pass, so the individual req was not verified. The row's shared "new-grad accepted" eligibility text is unsupported firm-wide.

Chicago is DRW's HQ and has ~44 live reqs, so the office is real — but the US is out of scope for this pass and the specific req was not verified. As with the other rows, the "New-grad OR entry-level req — recent grads accepted" eligibility text does not match DRW's actual C++ postings, which state 5-year minimums.

notes: Source of truth: DRW's own Greenhouse board (job-boards.greenhouse.io/drweng), which is what https://www.drw.com/work-at-drw/listings renders; enumerated all 164 live reqs via the public Greenhouse API and read the full description text for every in-scope candidate. Offices confirmed from https://www.drw.com/contact-us: Chicago, Amsterdam, Austin, Dubai, Greenwich, Hong Kong, Houston, London, Montreal, New York, Palo Alto, Singapore, Tel Aviv. IN SCOPE therefore: London (41 reqs), Singapore (16), Amsterdam (4), Hong Kong (1). NO Tokyo and NO Shanghai office — DRW has no APAC presence beyond Singapore and Hong Kong, so any Tokyo/Shanghai DRW row would be fabricated. Hong Kong's single live req is "Compliance Manager - Hong Kong", which is out of scope for all four tracks — so despite having an office, DRW currently has zero in-scope Hong Kong openings. Systemic finding: DRW's European/APAC engineering hiring is overwhelmingly senior (5-year minimums on every Core Infrastructure C++ req), and its genuinely junior seats are campus reqs with hard graduation-year windows (December 2026 - August 2027) that exclude a February 2026 graduate. The sweet spot for this candidate is the middle band: Senior Software Engineer C/FICCO Data (2+ yrs), Research Engineer FICCO (no years floor), AI Engineer, Quantitative Researcher - Machine Learning ("PhD or exceptional MSc"), Senior Software Engineer Trading Team (5 yrs only 'preferred', explicitly open to tech-company engineers), and London Quantitative Trading Analyst (1-2 yrs). Interns and campus reqs (FPGA Intern, Software Developer Intern, Quantitative Research Intern, Quantitative Trading Analyst Intern, Leadership Rotation Network) were excluded as out of scope. No compensation figures are stated on any in-scope posting — UK and EU postings carry no salary disclosure, so every comp_local is deliberately empty; the existing spreadsheet's comp ranges were not verifiable from any primary source. Only https://drw.com/work-at-drw/careers 404'd; every other page and posting loaded fine.
